info.title: Multi-Branch Inventory Engine
info.description:
Multi-branch inventory reservation and order processing engine.

1. Call **POST /api/v1/auth/login** to get an access token.
2. Click **Authorize** and paste the token.

All errors share one shape: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}, "request_id"}`.

post.description: Exchange email + password for a JWT access token.

get.description: The authenticated user, plus the permissions their role grants.
List users. Branch managers only ever see users of their own branch.

patch.description:
Update name, role, branch, password, or deactivate (`is_active: false`). Admin only.
Users are never deleted: their id is referenced by the stock ledger and audit trail.

get.description:
The branch directory. Visible to every signed-in user;
stock, orders and users of a branch remain restricted to that branch.

patch.description:
Update or deactivate (`is_active: false`) a branch. Admin only.
Refused with 409 while the branch has reserved stock, open orders or open transfers.

post.description: Add a product to the shared catalogue (admin only). Stock is added per branch via adjustments.

patch.description: Update or deactivate (`is_active: false`) a product. Admin only.

get.description: Stock levels (on hand / reserved / available) for every product held at a branch.

post.description:
Manual stock change with a mandatory reason: goods received (+), count corrections (+/-),
damage or loss (-). Units that are reserved can't be removed (409 `insufficient_stock`).
Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request can't apply the change twice.

schema.description: Unique per logical request (e.g. a UUID). Re-send the same key when retrying: the original response is returned and the work is not done twice.

post.description:
Create an order in **pending** state, or with `"reserve": true` create it and reserve its
stock in one transaction. If any line is short, nothing is created (409 `insufficient_stock`).

get.description: Orders, newest first. Staff and managers only see their own branch.

post.description:
**pending → reserved.** Atomically reserves every line, or nothing (409 `insufficient_stock`).
Calling it again on a reserved order changes nothing.
**reserved → confirmed** (e.g. payment received). No stock change.
**confirmed → fulfilled.** The goods leave: on hand and reserved both drop by the order quantities.

**pending / reserved / confirmed → cancelled.** Releases exactly the units this order holds.
Fulfilled orders can't be cancelled.

Request stock to move from one branch to another (status **requested**).
The requester must belong to the source or the destination branch. No stock moves yet.

get.description: Transfers in or out of a branch, newest first. Use `status=dispatched` to see stock in transit.

post.description:
**requested → approved** (source branch). Reserves the units at the source, all lines or none
(409 `insufficient_stock`).
**requested → rejected** (source branch). A reason is required. No stock effect.
**approved → dispatched** (source branch). The reserved units leave the source and are in transit.
**dispatched → received** (destination branch). Exactly the dispatched units are added at the destination.

**requested / approved → cancelled** (either branch). Releases any reservation at the source.
Not possible once dispatched: the goods are on the road.

get.description: Security and inventory audit trail, newest first. Branch managers see their own branch only.
